steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Component 2 is the applications paper that tests knowledge in real-world contexts and scenario-based problems. | Key Fact: Extended-response questions require structured answers with clear paragraphs, each making a distinct point linked to the scenario. | Key Fact: Design tasks ask you to propose a circuit or system solution; include a labelled diagram, component values and a brief explanation of operation. | Key Fact: Context-based questions present a real-world scenario (e.g. greenhouse control, alarm system); apply your knowledge to the specific context.
